product.title: The best and most complete PRIVATE CITY TOUR through the Historic Center

description.text: A private three-hour walk through Mexico City's Centro Histórico starts at the Monument to the Revolution and ends at the Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral on the Zócalo. A local guide reserved for one party covers historic-center streets, plazas, and landmark façades. Stops include Monument to the Revolution, Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral, Zócalo. The compact format orients first-time visitors without a full-day coach loop. Ideal for visitors basing in Mexico City who want a private historic-center walk without joining a mixed group.
